subtitle: Truck routes and driver tools
shortDescription: Plan truck routes, review restrictions, and connect with fellow drivers.
reviewNotes: Routing and road intelligence are advisory; posted signs, permits and official restrictions control.
Location is requested only for features that need it and is not declared as background location unless a native build later adds that capability.
Community content is user-generated; signed-in users can report posts, authors can remove their own posts, and users can immediately hide another driver's Community content on their device.
The Community hidden-driver list is stored locally on the device/browser and is not uploaded as a server-side profile attribute.
Account deletion is available from the Account screen and from a public web deletion page.
Saved-offer email/SMS delivery is opt-in; in-app saving does not require marketing consent.
Drivers Lounge Free Finds are curated public offers and are not represented as paid sponsorships.
